Class DefaultControlPanelRepository

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.controlpanel.core.DefaultControlPanelRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
ControlPanelRepository
@Singleton public class DefaultControlPanelRepository extends Object implements ControlPanelRepository
Default implementation of ControlPanelRepository that gets the control panels injected as beans, as well as dynamically created control panels.

1.0.0
Author:
